b01_contract.backlog_deliverable: B01: workflow registry, validators, immutable profile snapshot

workflow_identity_fields.api_workflow_version: OpenAPI Job requires workflow_version, but the source workflow does not define a separate semantic workflow_version field or mapping. Preserve workflow_id and schema_version distinctly until registry/version mapping is specified; do not silently equate schema_version with workflow_version.

acceptance_meaning.AT-04: Same-baseline design reuse is explicitly approved at X01; record SKIPPED with evidence; NEW_HW cannot skip required documentation.
acceptance_meaning.AT-28: A passing mock profile/evidence cannot authorize a real release.

b01_contract.validators_already_present: The supplied static design verifier checks workflow structure and OpenAPI component schema validity/references, and confirms only that the example profile remains disabled mock. It does not define or validate a project-profile JSON Schema, validate profile completeness, make immutable snapshots, or implement a live registry. Synthetic replay validators are mock scenario code and are not an operational API ingress validator.

real_environment_values_unresolved_by_pa: project_id (real project identity must be confirmed)
profile_inventory.secret_handling: Only field names and reference paths are recorded here. Secret values, credential material, and environment-specific identifiers are intentionally omitted. Profiles should contain approved references, not credentials.

implementation_boundaries.new_schema: A project-profile JSON Schema is a new implementation artifact, not an existing supplied original contract schema. Keep it versioned and explicitly map/validate the example profile against it.
implementation_boundaries.first_reusable_module: Implement a pure server-side profile/workflow contract validation and snapshot constructor under the future IFPMIC server package, and make the future authenticated job-creation ingress call it. A CLI may call the same module. Do not make a replay/mock-only validator the sole implementation, and do not add write routes to AX server/index.mjs.
implementation_boundaries.b02_boundary: B02 owns authenticated user-scoped API, authorization, DB persistence, and per-request workspaces. B01 validation may accept a trusted project context from ingress but cannot establish ownership/isolation itself.
implementation_boundaries.b03_boundary: B03 owns durable Temporal workflow execution, outbox, human waits, restart recovery and workflow version pinning. B01 may resolve immutable registry versions but does not execute or persist process transitions.
implementation_boundaries.ax_api_boundary: Current AX server/index.mjs is localhost-only and GET-only; it rejects non-GET API requests and exposes transcript dashboard/activity reads. Keep IFPMIC command/write ingress in a separate service boundary.

uncertainties: The project profile example supplies field names and a real-mode guard statement but no formal field-level schema or explicit list of required fields by mock versus real mode.
The OpenAPI contract requires workflow_version while the canonical workflow document contains workflow_id and schema_version; mapping/compatibility policy is not defined.
OpenAPI defines workflow/job APIs but no project-profile registry, profile approval, profile read, or immutable snapshot creation endpoint/schema.
No production values for repository, runtime/provider, build, quality, device, release, SSO, or approver policy were supplied; the profile is intentionally disabled mock.
